title: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, ABAP Platform, and SAP Web Dispatcher do not sufficiently handle resource…
description: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP, ABAP Platform, and SAP Web Dispatcher have a vulnerability related to insufficient handling of resource consumption when processing certain requests. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this by sending specially crafted requests that cause excessive resource utilization, leading to service disruption. The vulnerability impacts availability but does not affect confidentiality or integrity.
